name: merge_pull_request
description: Merge a pull request, only when the person asked for it. It must be a pull request of this conversation (its head is a commit you pushed) or one the person named, with its repository in full; its checks must have passed on the head commit that is merged (checked here); and, if it was opened with `accept_red_checks`, the person's newest message must name it and say to merge it. `repo` is a repository of your workspace or one the person named. `method` is `squash` (the default), `merge` or `rebase`; with `delete_branch: true` the pull request's branch is deleted afterwards, when it is a branch of that very repository. GitHub's own rules decide too (branch protection, required reviews, conflicts): if it refuses you get its words, and you tell the person; do not look for another way. It needs the auto access tier or above.

repo.description: The repository: its slot's name in your workspace, `owner/name`, or its address

delete_branch.description: Delete the pull request's branch after the merge (only a branch of that repository)
